ARCS kitMolecule 50term-definition

Term Definition

Let a reader who does not know a word see its plain meaning in place, on hover, focus or tap, with a link to the full glossary entry.

States

Anatomy

#PartType roleToken (CSS variable)
1TermInline <button> styled as text, dotted underline; solid and cyan when opentext, open cyan
2TipBelow the term (above when there is no room), at most 280px and never wider than its container or the viewportsurface, border, ds-r-sm
3DefinitionBold term then one or two plain sentences, 0.9remtext
4Glossary linkFull entry link, 600, at least 32px tallcyan

Usage

Use it when

  • Client pages where a term of art (MVP, scope, discovery) would stop a non-technical reader.
  • Define it once per section; later uses can stay plain.

Do not use it when

  • Do not put a definition on every repeat of a word, or on words a general reader knows.
  • Do not put actions other than the glossary link in the tip.

Data it reads

FieldTypeRequiredNote
termstringyesThe word as it appears in the sentence.
defstringyesOne or two plain sentences.
hrefstringnoThe full glossary entry, such as #glossary-mvp.

Access

  • The term is a <button> with aria-describedby pointing at the tip, so screen readers read the definition on focus even while it is hidden, and aria-expanded for its open state.
  • Escape closes the tip and keeps focus on the term; a tap pins it; a tap elsewhere closes it.
  • JS keeps the tip inside its container and the viewport, flipping it above when there is no room below.
  • Rem sizes; roomy spacing raises its line height to 1.8.
